mapper.select: select ID, ACCOUNTNUM, AMOUNT, CHARTNUM, CR_FUNC, CR_LOCAL, CURFXRATE, DESCRIPTION, DR_FUNC, DR_LOCAL, FUNCTIONCURRENCY, FXRATE, GLGROUPNUM, ISADJUSTED, ITEMNUM, LOCALCURRENCY, LOT, PRICE, RCPYREFNO, SECURITYDESCRIPTION, SECURITYID, SECURITYTYPECODE, TRANTYPE, UNIT, voucherNum from voucherdetails where ID = #{id,jdbcType=INTEGER}
mapper.insert:
select VoucherDetails_ID_SEQ.NEXTVAL from dual
insert into voucherdetails ( ID, ACCOUNTNUM, AMOUNT, CHARTNUM, CR_FUNC, CR_LOCAL, CURFXRATE, DESCRIPTION, DR_FUNC, DR_LOCAL, FUNCTIONCURRENCY, FXRATE, GLGROUPNUM, ISADJUSTED, ITEMNUM, LOCALCURRENCY, LOT, PRICE, RCPYREFNO, SECURITYDESCRIPTION, SECURITYID, SECURITYTYPECODE, TRANTYPE, UNIT, voucherNum ) values( #{id}, #{accountNum,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{amount,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{chartNum,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{cr_func,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{cr_local,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{curFxRate,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{description,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dr_func,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{dr_local,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{functionCurrency,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{fxRate,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{glGroupNum,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{isAdjusted,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{itemNum,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{localCurrency,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{lot,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{price,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{rcpyNo,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{securityDescription,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{securityID,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{securityTypeCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{tranType,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{unit,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{voucher.vouchernum,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.update: update voucherdetails set ID = #{id,jdbcType=INTEGER}, ACCOUNTNUM = #{accountNum,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, AMOUNT = #{amount,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, CHARTNUM = #{chartNum,jdbcType=INTEGER}, CR_FUNC = #{cr_func,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, CR_LOCAL = #{cr_local,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, CURFXRATE = #{curFxRate,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, DESCRIPTION = #{description,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, DR_FUNC = #{dr_func,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, DR_LOCAL = #{dr_local,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, FUNCTIONCURRENCY = #{functionCurrency,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, FXRATE = #{fxRate,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, GLGROUPNUM = #{glGroupNum,jdbcType=INTEGER}, ISADJUSTED = #{isAdjusted,jdbcType=INTEGER}, ITEMNUM = #{itemNum,jdbcType=INTEGER}, LOCALCURRENCY = #{localCurrency,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, LOT = #{lot,jdbcType=INTEGER}, PRICE = #{price,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, RCPYREFNO = #{rcpyNo,jdbcType=INTEGER}, SECURITYDESCRIPTION = #{securityDescription,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SECURITYID = #{securityID,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SECURITYTYPECODE = #{securityTypeCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TRANTYPE = #{tranType,jdbcType=INTEGER}, UNIT = #{unit,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, voucher = #{voucher.vouchernum,jdbcType=VARCHAR} where ID = #{id,jdbcType=INTEGER}
mapper.select: select vd.accountNum as acctnum, sum(vd.cr_func) as cr_func, sum(vd.dr_func) as dr_func, sum(vd.cr_local) as cr_local, sum(vd.dr_local) as dr_local from VoucherDetails vd,voucher vr where vd.vouchernum=vr.vouchernum and vr.ledgerDate=#{calDate} and vr.portfolionum=#{portnum} group by vd.accountNum

select vd.accountnum as acctnum, vd.securityid as secid, round(sum(vd.DR_LOCAL),2) as drLocalAmt, round(sum(vd.CR_LOCAL),2) as crLocalAmt, round(sum(vd.DR_FUNC),2) as drFuncAmt, round(sum(vd.CR_FUNC),2) as crFuncAmt, sum((case when v.JOURNALSOURCECODE<>18 then vd.DR_LOCAL else 0 end)) as drLocalAmtUnSet, sum((case when v.JOURNALSOURCECODE<>18 then vd.CR_LOCAL else 0 end)) as crLocalAmtUnSet, sum((case when v.JOURNALSOURCECODE<>18 then vd.DR_FUNC else 0 end)) as drFuncAmtUnSet, sum((case when v.JOURNALSOURCECODE<>18 then vd.CR_FUNC else 0 end)) as crFuncAmtUnSe, sum((case when v.ledgerdate=#{asOfDate} then vd.DR_LOCAL else 0 end)) as drLocalAmtToday, sum((case when v.ledgerdate=#{asOfDate} then vd.CR_LOCAL else 0 end)) as crLocalAmtToday, sum((case when v.ledgerdate=#{asOfDate} then vd.DR_FUNC else 0 end)) as drFuncAmtToday, sum((case when v.ledgerdate=#{asOfDate} then vd.CR_FUNC else 0 end)) as crFuncAmtToday, sum((case when v.ledgerdate=#{asOfDate} and v.JOURNALSOURCECODE <> 18 then vd.DR_LOCAL else 0 end)) as drLocalAmtUnSetToday, sum((case when v.ledgerdate=#{asOfDate} and v.JOURNALSOURCECODE <> 18 then vd.CR_LOCAL else 0 end)) as crLocalAmtUnSetToday, sum((case when v.ledgerdate=#{asOfDate} and v.JOURNALSOURCECODE <> 18 then vd.DR_FUNC else 0 end)) as drFuncAmtUnSetToday, sum((case when v.ledgerdate=#{asOfDate} and v.JOURNALSOURCECODE <> 18 then vd.CR_FUNC else 0 end)) as crFuncAmtUnSetToday, sum((case when v.ledgerdate<#{asOfDate} then vd.DR_LOCAL else 0 end)) as drLocalAmtLastDay, sum((case when v.ledgerdate<#{asOfDate} then vd.CR_LOCAL else 0 end)) as crLocalAmtLastDay, sum((case when v.ledgerdate<#{asOfDate} then vd.DR_FUNC else 0 end)) as drFuncAmtLastDay, sum((case when v.ledgerdate<#{asOfDate} then vd.CR_FUNC else 0 end)) as crFuncAmtLastDay, sum((case when v.ledgerdate<#{asOfDate} and v.JOURNALSOURCECODE <> 18 then vd.DR_LOCAL else 0 end)) as drLocalAmtUnSetLastDay, sum((case when v.ledgerdate<#{asOfDate} and v.JOURNALSOURCECODE <> 18 then vd.CR_LOCAL else 0 end)) as crLocalAmtUnSetLastDay, sum((case when v.ledgerdate<#{asOfDate} and v.JOURNALSOURCECODE <> 18 then vd.DR_FUNC else 0 end)) as drFuncAmtUnSetLastDay, sum((case when v.ledgerdate<#{asOfDate} and v.JOURNALSOURCECODE <> 18 then vd.CR_FUNC else 0 end)) as crFuncAmtUnSetLastDay from Voucher v, voucherdetails vd where v.portfolionum=#{portnum} and v.ledgerdate<=#{asOfDate} and v.vouchernum=vd.vouchernum group by vd.accountnum,vd.securityid

select vd.accountnum as acctnum, vd.securityid as secid, round(sum(vd.DR_LOCAL),2) as drLocalAmt, round(sum(vd.CR_LOCAL),2) as crLocalAmt, round(sum(vd.DR_FUNC),2) as drFuncAmt, round(sum(vd.CR_FUNC),2) as crFuncAmt, sum((case when v.JOURNALSOURCECODE<>18 then vd.DR_LOCAL else 0 end)) as drLocalAmtUnSet, sum((case when v.JOURNALSOURCECODE<>18 then vd.CR_LOCAL else 0 end)) as crLocalAmtUnSet, sum((case when v.JOURNALSOURCECODE<>18 then vd.DR_FUNC else 0 end)) as drFuncAmtUnSet, sum((case when v.JOURNALSOURCECODE<>18 then vd.CR_FUNC else 0 end)) as crFuncAmtUnSe, sum((case when v.ledgerdate=#{asOfDate} then vd.DR_LOCAL else 0 end)) as drLocalAmtToday, sum((case when v.ledgerdate=#{asOfDate} then vd.CR_LOCAL else 0 end)) as crLocalAmtToday, sum((case when v.ledgerdate=#{asOfDate} then vd.DR_FUNC else 0 end)) as drFuncAmtToday, sum((case when v.ledgerdate=#{asOfDate} then vd.CR_FUNC else 0 end)) as crFuncAmtToday, sum((case when v.ledgerdate=#{asOfDate} and v.JOURNALSOURCECODE <> 18 then vd.DR_LOCAL else 0 end)) as drLocalAmtUnSetToday, sum((case when v.ledgerdate=#{asOfDate} and v.JOURNALSOURCECODE <> 18 then vd.CR_LOCAL else 0 end)) as crLocalAmtUnSetToday, sum((case when v.ledgerdate=#{asOfDate} and v.JOURNALSOURCECODE <> 18 then vd.DR_FUNC else 0 end)) as drFuncAmtUnSetToday, sum((case when v.ledgerdate=#{asOfDate} and v.JOURNALSOURCECODE <> 18 then vd.CR_FUNC else 0 end)) as crFuncAmtUnSetToday, sum((case when v.ledgerdate<#{asOfDate} then vd.DR_LOCAL else 0 end)) as drLocalAmtLastDay, sum((case when v.ledgerdate<#{asOfDate} then vd.CR_LOCAL else 0 end)) as crLocalAmtLastDay, sum((case when v.ledgerdate<#{asOfDate} then vd.DR_FUNC else 0 end)) as drFuncAmtLastDay, sum((case when v.ledgerdate<#{asOfDate} then vd.CR_FUNC else 0 end)) as crFuncAmtLastDay, sum((case when v.ledgerdate<#{asOfDate} and v.JOURNALSOURCECODE <> 18 then vd.DR_LOCAL else 0 end)) as drLocalAmtUnSetLastDay, sum((case when v.ledgerdate<#{asOfDate} and v.JOURNALSOURCECODE <> 18 then vd.CR_LOCAL else 0 end)) as crLocalAmtUnSetLastDay, sum((case when v.ledgerdate<#{asOfDate} and v.JOURNALSOURCECODE <> 18 then vd.DR_FUNC else 0 end)) as drFuncAmtUnSetLastDay, sum((case when v.ledgerdate<#{asOfDate} and v.JOURNALSOURCECODE <> 18 then vd.CR_FUNC else 0 end)) as crFuncAmtUnSetLastDay from Voucher v, voucherdetails vd, TranBasic tb where v.portfolionum=#{portnum} and v.ledgerdate<=#{asOfDate} and v.vouchernum=vd.vouchernum and v.journalSourceCode=15 and v.taNum=tb.id and tb.trantype!=900 group by vd.accountnum,vd.securityid

select coa.closetoaccntnum as acctnum,vd.accountnum as closeToacctnum, sum(vd.dr_func-vd.cr_func) as dr_func,sum(vd.dr_local-vd.cr_local) as dr_local from voucher v, voucherdetails vd, coaa coa where v.vouchernum=vd.vouchernum and vd.chartnum=coa.chartnumber and v.ledgerdate<=#{ledgerDate} and v.portfolionum=#{portnum} and coa.CLOSETOACCNTNUM is not null and coa.CLOSETOACCNTNUM != '' and vd.accountnum=coa.accntnum group by coa.closetoaccntnum, vd.accountnum

select voucherdet0_.ID as ID, voucherdet0_.voucherNum as voucherNum, voucherdet0_.ITEMNUM as ITEMNUM, voucherdet0_.ACCOUNTNUM as ACCOUNTNUM, voucherdet0_.CHARTNUM as CHARTNUM, voucherdet0_.DESCRIPTION as DESCRIPTION, voucherdet0_.ISADJUSTED as ISADJUSTED, voucherdet0_.LOCALCURRENCY as LOCALCURRENCY, voucherdet0_.FUNCTIONCURRENCY as FUNCTIONCURRENCY, voucherdet0_.FXRATE as FXRATE, voucherdet0_.SECURITYID as SECURITYID, voucherdet0_.SECURITYTYPECODE as SECURITYTYPECODE, voucherdet0_.CR_LOCAL as CR_LOCAL, voucherdet0_.DR_LOCAL as DR_LOCAL, voucherdet0_.CR_FUNC as CR_FUNC, voucherdet0_.DR_FUNC as DR_FUNC, voucherdet0_.PRICE as PRICE, voucherdet0_.UNIT as UNIT, voucherdet0_.AMOUNT as AMOUNT, voucherdet0_.CURFXRATE as CURFXRATE, voucherdet0_.LOT as LOT, voucherdet0_.RCPYREFNO as RCPYREFNO, voucherdet0_.TRANTYPE as TRANTYPE, voucherdet0_.GLGROUPNUM as GLGROUPNUM, voucherdet0_.SECURITYDESCRIPTION as SECURITYDESCRIPTION, coaa1_.ACCNTNAME as ACCTNAME from VOUCHERDETAILS voucherdet0_ inner join VOUCHER voucher2_ on voucherdet0_.voucherNum=voucher2_.VOUCHERNUM cross join COAA coaa1_ where voucherdet0_.CHARTNUM=coaa1_.CHARTNUMBER and voucherdet0_.ACCOUNTNUM=coaa1_.ACCNTNUM and voucherdet0_.voucherNum=#{voucherNum}
